_about: Election calendar for the scheduled jobs (.github/elections.py reads it). One row per election per city.
voting_from..day (the city's local dates): fetch-voting.yml refreshes that city's voting places every morning.
day+1..results_until: fetch-representatives.yml refreshes that city daily (results feed its representatives file),
on top of the weekly Monday run for every city. No hourly election-night runs: on election night, run
'Refresh representatives' by hand for the city. Add the next election here when it's announced; past rows can stay.
